description: Get the full Paraguay procurement record for a process from the official DNCP Open Contracting (OCDS) API. Pass the numeric process id (e.g. 291566) or the ocid (e.g. "ocds-03ad3f-291566-1"). Returns the compiled OCDS release: ocid, title, buyer, contract value + currency (PYG), status, procurement method, key dates, tender items, and awards (suppliers + award amounts). Field values are in Spanish; keys are English.
name: paraguay_get_record
title: Paraguay Get Record
